root_cause_label: Naive Flat-File Assumption for ELF Memory Extraction
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented a naive script that treats the ELF binary as a flat memory space starting at a hardcoded base address (0x400000), skipping ELF header parsing, so all extracted addresses and values are wrong relative to the actual section-mapped virtual memory layout.
t_err_evidence: treat the file as memory and extract values... baseAddress = 0x400000... memoryAddress = baseAddress + i
t_commit_evidence: Once the naive script is written in step 8 and all subsequent steps (9-26) only re-run, validate format, and verify JSON validity of this same wrong script, the failing outcome is locked in at step 8.
trigger_explanation: The agent acts on the false premise that reading all 4-byte values from the raw binary file starting at a hardcoded base address 0x400000 is equivalent to extracting the actual virtual memory layout of ELF sections. A correct solution requires parsing ELF program/section headers to determine actual virtual addresses for each mapped section (.text, .data, .rodata), rather than treating the file as a flat byte array.
